cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 R14.41 AUDIT LAB — 362 RF Cases & Gear BACK Fix
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.41 audit correction: source-SHA-stamped CI firmware with BUILD/SHA and CATALOG ID-count/digest commands, strict RUN 3–30s decimal-token validation, and transmitter END reported only after radio shutdown is requested. R14.38 LAB: 362 bounded synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi RF test cases. Corrected gear-menu navigation: BACK from Test Library, Quick Find, Favorites and TX History returns to the gear Main Menu, while nested library and home-origin paths retain their parent screen. Settings child BACK for Battery, Identity, Help, Recovery and Display returns to the first Settings page in both landscape and portrait. Upstream v1.50 static table 220/220 mapped to candidate emissions; receiver hardware validation remains pending. SHA-256 multi-part CYD 3.2 flashing.
highlights: R14.41: CI build identity, catalog verification telemetry, strict serial RUN parser and post-stop TRUTH END ordering.
111 additional v1.50 Wi-Fi manufacturer-prefix SoftAP transmitters, individually selectable.
3 additional BLE service UUID advertisements; full FFFA Remote ID emission already available.
220/220 upstream static lookup entries mapped to candidate emissions; 362 total cases.
Active AP BSSID readback and bounded retry before reporting RF transmission.
10 fork-only OUI cases retained; case-unique MACs support expanded fixture library.
LAB only, physical receiver pass/fail unverified; no automatic RF transmission.
Gear-menu BACK routing for four entries plus nested category paths, tested in landscape and portrait.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8 R14.41 AUDIT LAB — 362 Hardware RF Cases
c5-waveshare-28.summary: R14.41 audit correction: source-SHA-stamped CI firmware with BUILD/SHA and CATALOG ID-count/digest commands, strict RUN 3–30s decimal-token validation, and transmitter END reported only after radio shutdown is requested. R14.37 LAB (boot catalog-count fix): 362 bounded synthetic on-air BLE/Wi-Fi cases. Added all 111 remaining v1.50 OUI-prefix SoftAP transmissions and 3 BLE UUID advertisements, preserving 10 fork-only cases and previous 238 fixtures. Hardware confirms active Wi-Fi AP MAC after startup; retries failed AP starts once. Upstream v1.50 source table mapping 220/220 candidate fixtures. Not a claim of complete parser/behavioral or physical receiver validation. SHA-256 multi-part flashing for Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8.

LAB only, physical receiver pass/fail unverified; no automatic RF transmission.
All three board boot banners now report the compiled scenario count rather than stale 172-case text.
